summary.one_liner: A status line for Claude Code that shows 5-hour and 7-day rate-limit usage, reset countdowns, context window, and prompt-cache freshness in one line at the bottom of the terminal.
summary.what_it_does: Adds a configurable status bar (command `cs`) to Claude Code's statusLine hook. The usage line shows 5h and 7d rate-limit bars with reset countdowns, end-of-window projections (shown as →NN%), model and context window, and a prompt-cache countdown (❄ 4m23s) indicating when the next turn pays full price. Optional segments include session cost, relay balance, git ahead/behind, activity, IP checks, and an IELTS writing-coach progress display. The project line shows git worktree marker, project name, branch, session +/− line counts, duration, and version. It uses a native cache reader and a background daemon for refresh, and offers three visual styles with a theme picker and a CLI for configuration. The README says the quota numbers are the official 5h and 7d limits rather than a local estimate.
use_cases: see when Claude Code quota resets
track context window size in Claude Code
check prompt cache expiry before a turn
customize Claude Code terminal status line
view git branch and session line changes in Claude Code
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | bash  (prebuilt binary for macOS Apple Silicon and Linux x86_64)
pip install claude-statusbar  (or: uv tool install / pipx install)
cs --setup  (wires the statusLine hook and installs the skill)
cs theme  (pick a theme with live preview)
cs config show  (list all keys and which ones changed)
notable: Shows official 5h and 7d rate-limit numbers with reset countdowns and end-of-window projections
Prompt-cache countdown showing when the next turn pays full price
Three visual styles and a live theme picker; configurable by CLI or a skill
Native cache reader plus background daemon, stated to use well under 1% CPU at one refresh per second
Companion ccx menu bar app on macOS reads its rate_limits data and warns near quota limits
caveats: The prebuilt binary covers only macOS Apple Silicon and Linux x86_64; other platforms need pip
Relies on the Claude Code statusLine hook and reads rate-limit data from Claude Code
The companion ccx feature is macOS-only per the README
keywords: see how much claude quota is left
